campaign.selectedSourceSet: R9-R08 decision-section producer, v2 authority/read-set validator, and isolated negative tests
campaign.permittedWork: Versioned PDP-0 producer/validator review and isolated tests only; no canonical source, authority, status, or apply writes.

findings.evidence: The new isolated test verifies that changing only the PXD-225 Authority subsection changes the full-section, authority-subsection, and whole-file hashes while preserving Decision/Currentness/Boundary semantic pins. Separate authority-map selectors are independently pinned. Appending PXD-228 does not create an authority binding; the four external authority selectors remain unallocated and the final whole-log apply hash remains null.

The v2 guard suite rejects live whole-log drift, authorization/preimage mismatch, missing/reordered/duplicate read-set members, extra/reordered write targets, and the decision log as a write target. The tests exercise the pure validator with in-memory fixtures; they do not exercise a lease, journal, filesystem snapshots, or effects.

The v2 guard rejects an identity string where current role evidence is required and checks four distinct identities plus credential/grant reference digests. These are caller-supplied actorTrust fixture fields; the inspected guard does not resolve those references against a trusted registry or authenticate their current status.

The v2 guard documents that the writer should call admission under the shared lock immediately before snapshots, but no R9-R08 commit/writer function is present in the inspected CAS module. Existing R8 writer uses its own profile and requires the old whole decision-log preimage. Therefore under-lease drift rejection before journal/snapshot/target effects is not yet proven for R9-R08.

The approval-input producer --check and its approval producer tests fail because the generated apply-authorization schema artifact differs from deterministic replay. A prior check also reported the expected r10 source-owner schema mismatch. Candidate outputs were not regenerated or overwritten in this review.

nextLegalAction: Reconcile the producer-generated candidate schemas through their versioned owner workflow, then add an R9-R08 writer that resolves actor trust from an authoritative registry and invokes the v2 guard under the shared lease immediately before snapshots. Add isolated filesystem/lock tests before any authority records or apply attempt.
